{'english': 'Earlier this month, OpenAI launched its first GPT-6 model equipped with Astra. The GPT-6 family is now joined by two new members: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.', 'chinese': '本月較早前，OpenAI 推出首個配備 Astra 的 GPT-6 模型。如今 GPT-6 系列再添兩名新成員，分別為 GPT-6 Sol 及 GPT-6 Luna。'}

{'english': 'GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now available', 'chinese': 'GPT-6 Sol 及 GPT-6 Luna 現已推出'}

{'english': "According to the ChatGPT desktop app's release notes, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna require fewer tokens to run than their GPT-5.6 counterparts.", 'chinese': '根據 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式的版本說明，GPT-6 Sol 及 GPT-6 Luna 運行所需 token 較其對應的 GPT-5.6 版本更少。'}

{'english': 'GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are rolling out to Codex and ChatGPT Work with lower token pricing than their GPT-5.6 predecessors. Sol is suited for complex coding and agentic workflows, while Luna is suited for focused, high-throughput tasks. The two models will roll out gradually to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free and Go users get Luna on the desktop app. Actual availability depends on the rollout schedule and configuration; admins must turn on new models before they can be used in an enterprise. In ChatGPT, the new models are already available in Work and Codex, but not yet in Chat.', 'chinese': 'GPT-6 Sol 及 GPT-6 Luna 正陸續推送至 Codex 及 ChatGPT Work，並較上一代 GPT-5.6 採用更低 token 定價。Sol 適合處理複雜編程及代理式工作流程，Luna 則適合專注且高吞吐量的任務。兩款模型將逐步開放予 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 及 Edu 用戶。免費及 Go 用戶可於桌面應用程式使用 Luna。實際可用情況視乎推送時間表及相關配置；企業管理員須先啟用新模型才可運作。在 ChatGPT 中，新模型已適用於 Work 及 Codex，惟 Chat 目前尚未提供。'}

{'english': 'Notably, no GPT-6 Terra model was announced this time. OpenAI has reportedly dropped the mid-size tier and is now keeping three tiers: Terra (small), Sol (large), and Astra (extra large).', 'chinese': '值得注意的是，今次並無推出 GPT-6 Terra 模型。OpenAI 據報已取消中型型號，僅保留三個等級：Terra（細）、Sol（大）及 Astra（特大）。'}

{'english': 'Below is what OpenAI had to say officially:', 'chinese': '以下為 OpenAI 官方公布內容：'}

{'english': "While the most demanding and important projects still benefit from the full depth of Astra, real-world work comes in different sizes, paces, and budgets. That's why we're expanding the GPT-6 family with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-6 Astra opened a new generation of intelligence, and these new models extend those advantages further, pushing the limits on cost-efficiency. Trained with methods similar to those used for GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol and Luna bring Astra's frontier capabilities in professional work, accuracy, coding, computer use, and alignment to faster, more economical models.", 'chinese': '雖然最艱巨且最重要的項目仍需 Astra 的完整深度，但現實工作無論在規模、節奏以至預算上皆有所不同。這正是我們以 GPT-6 Sol 及 GPT-6 Luna 擴展 GPT-6 家族的原因。GPT-6 Astra 開創了新世代智能，而這些新模型將相關優勢進一步延伸，在成本效益上推進極限。GPT-6 Sol 及 Luna 採用與 GPT-6 Astra 相若的訓練方法，將 Astra 於專業工作、準確度、編程、電腦操作及對齊方面的頂尖表現，帶到更快、更具經濟效益的型號之上。'}

{'english': 'The company says the two newest models are not only more affordable than Astra (and the GPT-5.6 version it replaces) but also more capable. For instance, the GPT-6 versions of Sol and Luna are priced 50% lower than the GPT-5.6 versions.', 'chinese': '公司表示，這兩款最新型號不僅較 Astra（及其所取代的 GPT-5.6 版本）更實惠，性能亦更強。例如 Sol 及 Luna 的 GPT-6 版本定價較 GPT-5.6 版本低 50%。'}

{'english': 'On availability, OpenAI says the two new models will be rolled out in batches throughout the day.', 'chinese': '關於可用性，OpenAI 表示兩款新模型將於全日內分批推送。'}
